### [component] Reshaped Radio  [id: 17933]
by reshaped
Works like a native radio button with value passed to the form on submission, in controlled or uncontrolled mode. Comes in three sizes, supports error and disabled states, and a RadioGroup compound for exclusive selection with any layout, FormControl group labels and card-based composition.
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/larsen66/reshaped-radio/cards/preview.1783441236441.png
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/reshaped/reshaped-radio?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 17933 })

### [component] Slider  [id: 35040]
by kuratlielia
A draggable range/value slider input with a rolling-number value bubble, rubber-band drag resistance, marks, and keyboard support.

install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/kuratlielia/slider?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"

### [component] Slider  [id: 34777]
by halaska-studio
A labeled numeric slider with a live value readout, available as a native range input or as a draggable spring-animated track with a thumb that grows while held.

### [component] Slider [react-aria-components]  [id: 827]
by jolbol1
A slider allows a user to select one or more values within a range.

The <input type="range"> HTML element can be used to build a slider, however it is very difficult to style cross browser. Slider helps achieve accessible sliders that can be styled as needed.
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/user_jolbol1/slider/827/preview.png
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/jolbol1/slider?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 827 })

### [component] Slider  [id: 31347]
by wensity
An accessible range slider with single and dual thumbs, steps and a value bubble that appears on drag or focus. Use it for prices, volume and filter ranges.
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/wensity/slider/default/preview.1790294656195-54a8c983-2e76-484e-86f1-9e96b4903c02.png
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/wensity/slider?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 31347 })
